description: Phase 3 Telugu reasoning finetuning: starts from the Phase 2 pretrained checkpoint, tokenizer/vocab fixed, finetunes on the synthetic comparative-reasoning QA set (8000 train examples, see finetune/data/). Loss is masked to answer tokens only. Lower learning_rate than pretraining since this is adapting an already-trained model to a narrow templated task, not learning language from scratch. num_epochs raised to 20 (full pass over all 8000 train examples per epoch, ~500 steps/epoch) since val loss on the prior 5-epoch run bottomed out around epoch 2 then rose (overfitting on the templated data) -- finetune.py now selects checkpoint_best.pt (lowest val loss) for the final test-set accuracy, so extra epochs searching for a better minimum are free of the overfitting risk that motivated the original epoch count.
